study_type: Post-incident numerical-runtime audit; no new policy experiment
documentation_timing: Runtime arms were committed before dispatch. This protocol file documents that already-dispatched, predefined diagnostic; it is not claimed to predate the original primary experiment or incident.

reference_environment.numpy_mask: Only actual compiled dispatch named X86_V4 or AVX512*; none on original X86_V2 baseline/X86_V3 dispatch; empty mask is a recorded no-op
reference_environment.selection_basis: Observed original physical CPU capabilities, never policy/test performance or success-selected fallback

invariants: Original 45/46/48, primitives and decode source hashes unchanged
Same frozen models, raw features, labels and split identities in both arms
No training, acquisition, parameter or tolerance changes
Independent child process before NumPy/Torch import per arm
Preserve both successful and failed original checker exits and full branches
acceptance: Only the predefined reference runtime may enter full, unchanged 46 and 48 verification; every original CP, action, accounting and numerical assertion must pass. Read-only diagnosis alone is not acceptance.
failure_action: Do not search alternative ISA settings. Preserve the default failure and report any reference failure; do not label failed replay equivalent.

cost_accounting.subsequent_full_reference_audit: Separate exact-recorded candidate replay, reported by unchanged46 receipt; not independent new samples

coverage_scope: A pinned reference replay does not establish default cross-CPU/BLAS equivalence or transfer coverage to a different numerical mapping.
